tests.name: Seed charts reflect the 14 real marks and 51 elapsed planned practices; future disabled
New daily habit starts today, supports marking and persists after reload
Specific weekdays validate selection and disable days outside the selected schedule
Weekly target supports 1–7 and caps credited performance without hiding recorded marks
Changing a frequency preserves historical marks and allows undo of a previously checked transition day
Habit selection and week/month/date controls update the correct views
Marking synchronizes chart, dashboard, history and keyboard focus
Upload stays in preview until save, cancel discards, remove persists and invalid files are rejected
Pause, resume, archive and restore preserve saved records and archived filters
Storage failure rolls back a mark, creation, edit and pause while retaining form input
Chart data tables and no-habits states offer usable alternatives
Onboarding weekday draft survives reload and reaches the habit module with the same cadence
Mobile layout retains controls and keyboard Escape cancels without committing
